    if r2.get('level_completed') or r2.get('done'): raise SystemExit

print('blue:',Wpos(current_frame),{k:r3.get(k) for k in ('level_completed','done','no_impact')})
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print('bar p:',a[-1].count('p'),'w:',a[-1].count('w'))
